premise: A lamp-keeper's daughter framed for theft is rescued by a hooded harbourmaster who is a lord thought drowned. He offers marriage to clear her name while her sister's family plots against them.

characters.visual_descriptor: a young woman in a grey wool shawl

characters.role: Mara's sister, who planted the ring
characters.visual_descriptor: a haughty woman in a green gown

characters.role: harbour mayor who orders Mara arrested
characters.visual_descriptor: a stout man in a chain of office
a scarred man in a dark hood
a pale older woman in black gloves

arcs.name: The stolen ring
arcs.summary: Mara is framed at the feast and saved by the harbourmaster.

arcs.name: The poisoned wedding
arcs.summary: The widow poisons the wedding wine.

key_reveals.description: The hooded harbourmaster is Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned
The widow poisoned the wedding cup
